summary.en: President De la Espriella has intensified militarization in Cúcuta and along the Venezuelan border as alleged Venezuelan forces bombed an ELN camp and a separate strike reportedly killed at least 19 near the border. Colombian forces have charged nine former FARC commanders with war crimes while conducting an anti-narcotics operation that has drawn scrutiny over civilian killings. US troops have arrived in Colombia under Operation Condor, and the UN Verification Mission in Colombia has had its mandate renewed by the Security Council. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: President De la Espriella har økt militariseringen i Cúcuta og langs den venezuelanske grensen etter påståtte venezuelanske styrker som bombet en ELN-leir, og et separat angrep som ifølge rapporter drepte minst 19 personer nær grensen. Colombias styrker har siktet ni tidligere FARC-kommandører for krigsforbrytelser mens de gjennomførte en narkotikabekjempelsesoperasjon som har fått kritikk for sivile drap. Amerikanske soldater har ankommet Colombia under Operasjon Condor, og FN-verifiseringsmisjonen i Colombia har fått fornyet mandat av Sikkerhetsrådet. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
